description.message: Use the local GeminiForge server to work with files, run commands, and control your computer from Gemini.

modeNote.message: This setting controls the extension’s JSON tools. Gemini handles MCP approvals separately.

autoPrompt.message: Add tool instructions to new chats

autoHint.message: Prepend tool instructions to the first message in a new chat

notify.message: Notify me when Gemini is done

notifyHint.message: Show a desktop notification when Gemini finishes replying, needs your confirmation, or hits an error. "Only when away" notifies only while you are on another tab or app; "Always" also notifies while you are on this tab

notifyTestBody.message: This is a GeminiForge test notification.

notifyTestSent.message: Test notification sent. If you don't see it, check Windows notification settings and Do not disturb.

alwaysHint.message: Allow this tool for the rest of this chat

updated.message: The extension was updated. Refresh this page.

noEditor.message: Gemini’s message field was not found.

consent.message: Accept the upload consent dialog in Gemini.

missingImage.message: The image did not appear in the message field.

cancelSend.message: Send canceled because the input mode or chat changed.

sendTimeout.message: Send is unavailable. The image may still be uploading.

stalled.message: No response from Gemini for {s} seconds. Stopped it and asked again.

stallNudge.message: [GeminiForge] Your last reply stalled and produced nothing. Continue from the latest results above.

stallGiveUp.message: Gemini keeps stalling without a reply. Check the page, then send a message to continue.

denied.message: The user declined this tool. Try another approach or ask the user.

returned.message: Round {n} results sent. Waiting for Gemini…

lastShot.message: Attached the last screenshot taken after {tool}.

next.message: Continue based on these results. When finished, summarize in plain text without further tool blocks.

busy.message: A tool is running. Stop it first.

hasPrompt.message: Tool instructions are already in the message field.

inserted.message: Instructions inserted. Enter your request and send it.

accessRequest.message: {client} is requesting access to this computer to read and write files, run commands, and control the mouse and keyboard.

pairCode.message: Enter the pairing code shown in the GeminiForge server window.

tooMany.message: Too many attempts. Try again in 10 minutes.

srvPortInUse.message: Error: port {port} is already in use by another program. Set the GF_PORT environment variable to use another port (also change it in the extension's manifest.json and background.js).

srvStop.message: Emergency stop: fling the mouse into any screen corner. Close this window to stop the server.

mcpTitle.message: GeminiForge MCP server (for Gemini's @ custom app)

mcpNoPopup.message: No approval popup can be shown ({why}), so actions that need approval are denied. Install zenity, or set "approval" to "none" in server/mcp_config.json.

srvStopPlain.message: Press Ctrl+C or close this window to stop the server.

mcpStopPlain.message: Press Ctrl+C or close this window to stop.

mcpTunnelQuick.message: Quick tunnel: this address changes every time the server starts. After each start, put the new URL into the custom app in Gemini and pair again.

mcpTunnelMissing.message: cloudflared was not found. Install it (Windows: winget install Cloudflare.cloudflared, macOS: brew install cloudflared, Linux: the package from Cloudflare's downloads page), or set "tunnel" back to "tailscale" in server/mcp_config.json.

mcpTunnelFailed.message: cloudflared did not report a tunnel address within 30 seconds. Check the internet connection and try again.

mcpStop.message: Emergency stop for mouse actions: fling the mouse into a screen corner. Close this window to stop.

mcpWrongCode.message: Someone entered a wrong pairing code

mcpPortInUse.message: Error: port {port} is already in use by another program. Set the GF_MCP_PORT environment variable to use another port.

bkTooLarge.message: (file is over {mb} MB; content not backed up)

bkWasMissing.message: did not exist (restore = delete the file)

bkNotFound.message: Backup {id} not found; look up ids with list_backups.

bkNoContent.message: Backup {id} has no content (the file was too large) and cannot be restored.

bkRestored.message: Restored {path} to its content from before {time}

bkDeleted.message: {path} did not exist before, so it was deleted (its content is backed up)

bkNothing.message: {path} did not exist then and does not exist now; nothing to restore

usageFailed.message: Could not read the usage page

usageRefresh.message: Refresh usage (opens gemini.google.com/usage in a background tab for a few seconds)

usageLimit.message: Gemini usage limit reached; replies may stop until it resets.

handoffHint.message: Opens a new chat in another Google account signed in to this browser and carries over the original request and the progress so far. The percentage is that account's usage as last read here. If the accounts cannot be listed they are shown by number: Account 1 is the default account, the rest follow in sign-in order.

handoffCollecting.message: Loading the conversation… ({n} messages; Stop cancels)

handoffNoTask.message: (The original request could not be loaded. Work out the goal from the log below; if it is not clear, ask the user before doing anything.)

handoffOpened.message: Opened a new chat on {name} to continue the task

handoffResuming.message: Picking up a task from another account…

handoffWrongAccount.message: {name} is not signed in to this browser; handoff cancelled

handoffIntro.message: [GeminiForge handoff] This task was being worked on in another chat that stopped at its usage limit, and you are taking it over. Below are the original request (TASK) and a log of the work so far (LOG; older entries are shortened or left out, and earlier screenshots are not attached). Files already written and commands already run have left their results on this computer.

handoffNext.message: First use the tools to check the actual current state (read files or take a screenshot again where needed), then continue from where the work stopped. Do not redo steps that are already done.

handoffNoAccount.message: No other Google account is signed in to this browser

handoffPartial.message: The start of the chat did not load; the handoff goes without the original request

handoffEmpty.message: This chat has nothing to hand off yet
